Mobile stability check — remove all discovered original AniLife website links and TV behavior from mobile APK
Source head: d57cd2471c44cef51a880548a04e64c9e6edfb23
User-facing website links removed from About and Settings search, and original downloads URL removed from update-certificate mismatch error; no changes to internal anilife:// deep link handling or required credits.
Mobile product flavor retains unchanged package ID, Cast, baseline profiles, download, authentication and player code. Mobile UI always uses handheld/tablet layouts, mobile services do not detect TV, and common manifest no longer exposes LEANBACK_LAUNCHER. The separate TV flavor's launcher is confined to its own manifest for source/CI compatibility but no TV APK is published by this preview workflow. The TV flavor is not deleted because doing so risks breaking shared mobile build infrastructure.
Unit regression verifies missing website link, no TV mode selector, mobile launcher intent not present, and required Morphe credit maintained. Verify mobile unit tests, lint, universal debug APK and signature before replacing preview release; leave main/stable untouched.
